LOOK: Actor, comedian, and It’s Showtime host Vice Ganda shows support for the upcoming September 21 anti-corruption protest in Luneta, Manila. 

Vice posted on their Instagram story an image of protesters with the text:

‘Magkita-kita tayo sa Luneta. Oras na para wakasan ang kagarapalan ng mga hayup na magnanakaw sa gobyerno.’
